Results.ReviewText: First Weber does not disappoint!  Solid and well made.  I was interested in a grill with a side sear box.  I chose the Weber because of its reputation and recommendations by family and friends.  I figured Weber knew what they were doing more than me!  I am very happy the sear zone is inside the grill.  Easier to clean, swap the grates to burn off residue, and heats up the grill faster.  I love the cast grates for even cooking.  I previously had a 4 burner grill and never needed all the space.  I can easily cook 6-8 big steaks or 24 large burgers on my Weber Spirit which is plenty!
Results.Title: First Weber

Results.ReviewText: Avoid.  Bought this and had it assembled, the top shelf was bent but passed off to me as "okay by weber standards" according to the sales and installer.  Tried to work with Weber support but they do not care.  Its cheaply made Chinese parts with a weber logo on it.  Spend your money elsewhere and get quality, this isn't your father Weber anymore.  I should have known something was wrong when the sales man was pushing a customer in front of me to buy multiple grill covers because they rip easily.

Two: The last Weber I bought had a very nice cook book. This one has none - would appreciate the ease of using it while grilling.
Results.Title: Good machine needs refinements

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill and I have used it several times with great results.  It was the perfect size for my needs and the two shelves that fold down make it even more compact when not in use.  My only negative is the absence of a back panel which is why I rated 4 versus 5 stars.  Cooking-wise, so far 5 stars.  It seems odd that there would be fully enclosed sides and front with a door while the back is completely open.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-325 3 burner grill
